SELECT /*selectSellerMpIvObtnodrReceiptList*/ X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_CREATE_DATE, X.REF_NO, X.PO_NO, X.PO_AMT, X.PO_SEQ,
--X.납기요청일 --납기개선프로젝트로 표준납기일로 변경 20231123 HSJ, -- DECODE(X.PROCESS_TYPE, '0',X.ST_DATE, F_GET_DATE_TR(X.ST_DATE)) AS ST_DATE, X.ST_DATE AS ST_DATE, --거래유형이 TR이면 --수요일이면 납기요청일 -1일 --수요일이 아니면 납기요청일 -2일 WHY --TR이 아니면 납기요청일
X.PO_REMARK, X.BUYER, X.PROCESS_TYPE, X.BUYER2 , DECODE(X.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','') AS BFRE_STCK_YN , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME , (SELECT USR.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_PHONE_NUMBER ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGIMP WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN OPEN_DATE AND CLOSE_DATE AND COM_CODE = X.BUYER AND SLG_ID = 'P06-0000121') AS PORS_CHECK FROM ( SELECT MAX(F_GET_EXPORT_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, B.PO_NO, B.DELY_TO_LOCATION)) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(A.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, A.PO_NO AS PO_NO, SUM(DECODE(A.PR_TYPE, 'PX', B.AGENT_ITEM_AMT, B.ITEM_AMT)) AS PO_AMT, COUNT(B.PO_SEQ) AS PO_SEQ, MIN(B.ST_DATE) AS ST_DATE, MAX(A.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, MAX(B.BUYER) AS BUYER, MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE) PROCESS_TYPE, MAX(DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE, 'X', DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', B.WAREHOUSE_CODE, F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01')), F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01'))) AS BUYER2, MAX(C.REF_NO ) AS REF_NO --PX번호 , MAX(A.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE , MAX(NVL((SELECT MAX(COD3.CODE1) AS KEP_USER_ID FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'ISMG' AND C.PURCHASER_DEPT = COD3.CODE2 AND C.BUYER = COD3.BUYER), (SELECT MAX(MNG.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MNG.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND MNG.STATUS != 'O'))) AS KEP_USER_ID FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPRDT C WHERE A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.PR_NO = C.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = C.PR_SEQ AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.DS_FLAG = 'N' AND B.COMPLETE_MARK ='N' AND A.COMPLETE_MARK ='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS != 'D' AND CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_PO_MNG WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND STATUS = 'S' AND TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT4 = 'Y') ) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MHUB_CHG' AND TARGET = A.BUYER AND KEY_1 = A.PO_NO AND KEY_9 = 'N' ) = 0
AND (B.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_buyer_code})
AND (B.PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%') OR B.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%'))
AND C.REQ_USER_INFO LIKE '%'||#{st_req_user_info}||'%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO ) X
-- 1 : 고객사 ORDER BY BUYER_NAME, ST_DATE, PO_NO
-- 2 : 발주일▲ ORDER BY PO_CREATE_DATE
-- 3 : 주문번호 ORDER BY REF_NO
-- 4 : 발주번호 ORDER BY PO_NO
-- 5 : 발주총금액 ORDER BY PO_AMT
-- 6 : 품목수 ORDER BY PO_SEQ
-- 7 : 납기요청일 ORDER BY ST_DATE
-- 8 : 선입고여부 ORDER BY BFRE_STCK_YN
-- 9 : 발주일▼ ORDER BY PO_CREATE_DATE DESC
